# Square root of 10
```{r}
sqrt(10)
```

# Logarithm of 32 to the base 2
```{r}
log(32, base = 2)
```

# Sum of the numbers from 1 to 1000
```{r}
sum(1:1000)
```

# Sum of all even numbers from 2 to 1000
```{r}
sum(seq(from = 2, to = 1000, by = 2))
```

# Number of pairwise comparisons for 100 genes
```{r}
choose(100, 2)
```

# Number of ways to arrange 100 genes in triples
```{r}
100*99*98
```
